list: The official 55 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, from the cited sources. Where no source has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC — every trophy on this list is single-player. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup. Tick trophies off in this tracker as you earn them; the progress ring at the top shows how close the Platinum is.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1–5).
Complete the 100% Completion checklist for A Long Road.
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the remaining miscellaneous trophies.
The Platinum unlocks automatically with the 54th trophy.
trophies.tip: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours — long, not hard. There is no trophy that needs a second playthrough.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the first story trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1.
Play the main mission Gone Fishing to the end.
trophies.tip: Main missions show as pink icons with black letters on the map; optional missions are black icons with pink letters.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes, as the first mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?) begins. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in the game that might be missable: the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, at Jason's house on the morning after the mission Down to Earth.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1 main missions in order.
After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony to meditate.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens.
trophies.tip: There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — 15 manual slots are available.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 2; it ends when the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Chapter 2 is where most of the list opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and free-roam together, which unlocks the partner trophies and several questlines.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2 main missions in order.
After Coffee Break, start the partner and side content that opens up — but nothing here can be missed.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens.
trophies.tip: From Coffee Break on, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars whenever you see them — it all counts toward 100% later.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 3; it closes after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the robbery systems unlock — Yasmani's jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List — so take the side quests as they appear; quest givers who go quiet mid-story always come back later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3 main missions in order.
Do the optional missions as they appear — they introduce new systems and count toward the 100 optional missions.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops early in Chapter 4.
trophies.tip: Optional missions disappear after a while, but that never locks a trophy: there are far more than the 100 the checklist needs.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 4; it ends with the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 opens the big bank-vault robberies through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which is also the gateway to Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4 main missions in order.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it is marked — it teaches bank-vault robbery.
Finish the final mission of the chapter; the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: Keep a manual save before the end of the chapter. There is no mission replay, and a save at each chapter boundary is cheap insurance.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and one of only two golds on the list. Finish the final mission of the story and the trophy pops with the credits. Make a manual save before starting it — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save lets you go back to free roam cleanly. After the credits you return to the open world, and everything the 100% checklist needs is still available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to the end.
After the credits, free roam continues — start Phase 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.tip: The 100% Completion checklist only appears under Progress > Stats after the story, but progress made during the story already counts toward it.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end; it pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed — every story mission trophy unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: There are no mission gold medals in GTA VI, so you never need to replay a mission for a rating.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end; it pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: Heist missions are a good place to practise the robbery systems — partner calls, escapes and heat — that the later robbery trophies need.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end; it pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: Story mission trophies are all unmissable — if a mission is in your way, finishing it is the whole requirement.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end; it pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: If a story mission feels hard, remember there are no difficulty settings — everyone plays the same game, and no trophy asks for a harder mode.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end; it pops when the mission completes. The airport you visit here is the same one Catch Me If You Can needs later — but that trophy is a separate free-roam job, not this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: Note the airport layout while you are here: the docked planes at terminals E3/E4 matter for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end; it pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete it.
trophies.tip: Chapter 5 is the last chapter. After it, the final mission and then free-roam cleanup remain.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the second gold. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it can be missed. The requirements are forgiving: the checklist is roughly 60% of true completion. You need any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+), to scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals, complete 300 stunts, earn all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, finish all 42 drone time trials, complete any 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all of Bret's quests, and 15 of 18 meditations. Most of it falls out naturally while earning the other trophies; the roadmap's Phase 2 is built around it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Work the big counts as you go: scan vehicles with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1), study animals with binoculars (L1 wheel, zoom with Up, hold R1).
Clear the all-or-nothing rows: all robberies, all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults, all 42 shooting golds, all 42 drone trials, all of Bret's Target Decks.
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — the 10 hardest can be skipped.
trophies.tip: Each meditation spot counts +2 if you do it with both Jason and Lucia, and each of Moses' and Randy's vehicle deliveries counts as an optional mission.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. You can mix the kinds freely, so pick whatever is quickest for you — flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open the map and filter Exploration > Stunt Spots to see nearby stunts.
Do any 250 stunts across the four kinds — jumps, under bridges, knife flights, base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest; chain them along rivers and highways.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.
trophies.tip: The small challenges shown when you scroll over a stunt's map icon are not required — performing the stunt once is enough to count it.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Do each type once. You can check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and on the map by filtering for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon). Most of these happen naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so this is usually one of the first trophies to pop on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Do each missing type once — a round of golf, a game of pool, a fishing trip, a hunt, a race, a stunt.
Anything you have already done while playing the story already counts.
trophies.tip: If one type is missing late in the game, the quickest are a stunt jump and a game of pool — both take minutes.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting ranges. The challenges are not very difficult, but they are precise: use a steady aim, take your time on the timed lanes, and replay a challenge as often as you need — there is no penalty for retrying. Your Focus level rises as you play the ranges, which also helps Gunslinger later. Track the ranges on the map and in the Progress menu; the 100% checklist needs all 42 golds too, so this trophy and the checklist move together.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a shooting range — there are 12 across Leonida.
Play each range's challenges and earn gold in all 42 of them.
Replay any challenge freely until the gold medal lands.
trophies.tip: PowerPyx maps all 12 range locations and their 42 challenges; the gold thresholds are the same for every player, since there are no difficulty settings.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, three per location. You only need one win per location, not all 42, so if a location has a hard race, win its easiest one and move on. Learn the racing line first with a slow lap, then push: drones handle best with smooth, early turns. The 100% checklist is stricter and needs all 42 drone time trials, so this trophy is the easy half of the same job.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations — 14 across Leonida.
Win at least one race at each location.
Keep the other races for the 100% checklist, which needs all 42 time trials.
trophies.tip: A win counts even on the easiest race at a location, so never grind a hard race when an easy one at the same spot will do.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many races as you need — pick the 20 that suit you and skip the rest. Races include car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races, so the wins you collect for Top Fun and the race challenges all count here too. If a race is giving you trouble, switch to another location rather than grinding one track.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Race at different locations — 40 unique spots exist.
Win 20 different ones; each location's win counts once.
Use a fast, stable car and learn the track on a first slow run.
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist needs gold medals in 10 of 13 race challenges, so race wins early also bank progress toward that.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there: fish with him, learn the timing, and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks Master of None, and catching fish raises your Focus — useful for Gunslinger.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Play Chapter 1 until Feng Shui introduces Cal.
Wait for Cal's text and follow the purple fishing icon.
Fish the challenge and beat Cal's catch.
trophies.tip: If the text has not arrived yet, keep playing the story — Cal's questline is triggered by story progress, not by free-roam grinding.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — in-game they are called Video Games, and there are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward (they can be briefly unavailable during some story sections, but they are there again after the story). Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck).
Pick one of the four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Finish all of its levels once — challenges inside the game are optional.
trophies.tip: This is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and it can be done as early as Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy; she then texts you her home address, which marks the questline on the map in Belville. Complete all five of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) — and the trophy pops after the last one. Every quest stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia until Andy calls and texts her address in Belville.
Complete the five Andy quests in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops after the final quest.
trophies.tip: Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — her line is a named-character questline, not a stranger strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton), he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you dive to shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. After the first set he calls you back for more — seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but he returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, answer Kenton's call and visit his KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, and bring it back.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his repeated call-backs; the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.tip: Kenton's temporary absence after Chapter 1 is normal — he is not missable, and his quests are still there after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests in order — Thrillbillies (check out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job) — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's five quests in order.
The trophy pops after Hometown Heroes.
trophies.tip: Billy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — his line is a named-character questline.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Strangers are side quests you find in the open world — but only certain questlines count toward this trophy. Confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). Named-character lines — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and the others — do NOT count as strangers. You can check your count on the trophy tracker, and every stranger strand is still available after the story in free roam. More strangers are still being discovered, so if you finish the confirmed ones and still need strands, check the PowerPyx Strangers & Freaks guide for new finds.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger quest givers in the open world — they appear as you explore.
Finish full strands, not single missions: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Complete 8 strands in total; check the count on the trophy tracker.
trophies.tip: Do not waste time on named-character questlines for this trophy — Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone and Yasmani never count toward it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, then steal it and drive it back — in good condition, it pays more. His wanted cars are often parked outside hotels or driving around in east Vice City, around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and he marks new locations on the map as you complete the ones he gave you. The Zorrusso itself is delivered during the story mission; the other 15 are: Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to find the 16 on his Wish List.
Deliver each one to Randy's garage; the trophy pops after the last delivery.
trophies.tip: Track the list under Map > Robberies (money-bag icon) > Randy's Wish List, and steal cars anywhere — not only at his marked spots.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason — not as Lucia. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City; go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, switch to Jason.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down.
trophies.tip: Tyrone's labs are also good practice for the destruction and escape skills the robbery trophies need.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before you finish Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 meditations at the same location, and you can track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The catch is the very first meditation: during Chapter 1, at Jason's house, the morning after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept when prompted, and she teaches you to meditate. That offer disappears for good once Chapter 1 ends. It is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation is actually required for the trophy — it raises the counter by +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — but the guide's author earned the trophy after doing it, so doing it is the safe choice. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept and meditate.
After Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), visit all 18 meditation spots across the 10 locations.
Meditate with both characters at each spot for +2 per spot; track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.tip: If you already finished Chapter 1 without the balcony meditation, do not panic yet — it is unconfirmed whether it is required — but there is no way to go back without an earlier save, which is why this guide flags it in Phase 1 of the roadmap.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically some time after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason — Lucia cannot receive the message — you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. The line is exclusive to Jason. Go meet Bret; he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track progress under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, play as Jason until Bret's text arrives.
Meet Bret in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted) and take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.
Hunt the animals at his marked spots and bring them to him; keep clearing Target Decks.
trophies.tip: Hunting is one of the 9 activity types, and studying animals with the binoculars (100 of 255) is a separate 100% requirement — do both while you are out in the field.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total across Leonida, so you only need a sixth of them — pick the three sets whose cards are closest together and finish those first. Cards are found in the world as you explore; check the PowerPyx collectible-card locations guide for the set maps. This is a pure collectible grind with no combat and no time pressure, and it can be done entirely after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick three card sets to target first — there are 18 sets in total.
Collect every card in each chosen set.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.
trophies.tip: Do this alongside the WAiNK scans and the map unfogging: one exploration loop can feed three trophies at once.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone's WAiNK app: hold Up, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 — the categories are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Walk the busy areas of Vice City and scan everything the app highlights; landmarks cluster in the city centre and along the beachfront. Scanning also feeds the vehicle-discovery count, since the same app scans cars.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan).
Scan any 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or No Flusher tags.
The trophy pops at 100 scans; there are many more than 100 available.
trophies.tip: Scan vehicles with the same app as you walk between locations — Whip It Good (100 vehicles) and the 200-vehicle checklist row progress at the same time.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You can view and track them under Progress > Challenges — each one shows a Completed checkmark when done. Many complete on their own while you work on the other trophies and the 100% requirements, so leave this for late in the run: by then you will have a large number done without trying, and you can pick the easiest and quickest of the remainder. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there — the 10 hardest challenges can be skipped entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play normally and let challenges complete while earning other trophies.
Open Progress > Challenges to see what is left.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges until you reach 50 — then keep going to 70 for the checklist.
trophies.tip: Do not grind challenges early. They are designed to be finished last, when most of them are already done.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level (causing carnage will do it) and escape the red heat zone. The best escape is a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic out of the search area; if a helicopter is chasing you, shoot at it until it goes away. The easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank-vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest route.
trophies.tip: If you do the bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal first, you will probably earn this trophy without trying.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob three robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time. The trick is to keep the red/blue flashing wanted level and never let it drop to the red heat level or clear entirely. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store, ideally go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop — and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need that fourth shop anyway.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs, healing).
Rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the delayed pop; hit a fourth shop if it has not popped.
trophies.tip: Loot properly in each store — a couple of items plus the back-room safe — or the robbery may not count toward the chain.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly): look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive the vehicles. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) on a busy road.
Scan every new vehicle that passes (hold R1).
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles; keep scanning toward 200 for the checklist.
trophies.tip: Scan boats and aircraft too — they count toward the discovered total, and the checklist counts base models across all vehicle kinds.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top left, under health and stamina. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in a single use — and one use only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: buff your focus by eating, drinking, or washing your face and showering at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend the focus time. Then line up five enemies — the criminals at gang operations are ideal — and drop them quickly without missing. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover and get close. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang-operation criminals. It gets easier as your focus levels up — there are 4 focus levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye icon), raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and you will likely reach Focus Level 4 naturally while earning the other trophies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise your Focus level (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) and stock Adrenaline and body armor.
Find five clustered enemies at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down all five in the one use.
trophies.tip: If you are struggling, wait until Focus Level 4 and use Adrenaline — the extra seconds are the difference between four kills and five.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge; the planes parked out on the airfield do not work. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge — the door leads directly into the plane. (You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.) Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it unlocks.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km from the airport until it pops.
trophies.tip: Do not waste time on the airfield planes — only a plane docked to a boarding bridge counts.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it until the trophy pops. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; they stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank, and shoot enemies until it unlocks. Expect heavy resistance: the base is guarded, so bring body armor and be ready to fight your way out in the tank itself.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west of the map.
Enter the base (gate, or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance).
Get into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.tip: The tank is the reward and the weapon at once — once you are inside it, the base's own firepower stops being a problem.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry-store robberies, which appear as green icons in unfogged map areas. Now break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, you never need to equip it. When you approach a locked door you get a choice: kick it (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Pick the Snap Gun, get into the back room, find the note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store (green icon) — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good one.
Enter by the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe-code note, and loot the safe undetected.
trophies.tip: Never kick the door: the alarm is what fails the stealth requirement, and the Snap Gun prompt is the quiet way in.

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress. It introduces bank-vault robbery: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in quickly while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3, after you have done his two Payday Loans robberies — $10,000 for tips about security vans; he marks them with a purple icon, and you follow each one to its bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: any 5 earn this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 8. A single vault pays up to $205,000, making this the best money-maker in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to learn vault robbery.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his Payday Loans jobs) and follow the marked vans.
Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape each time — all 8 are needed for the checklist.
trophies.tip: Bring your partner to every vault: you cannot carry all the cash alone, and handing off a bag is part of the job.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe). Robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, because you tail the truck to the bank and the guard carries the cash to the vault; steal it all and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, you will earn this trophy automatically along the way. If you want it earlier, armored trucks also drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Either: finish That's Where The Money Is… and rob a large bank vault — it counts as the truck.
Or earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the heat radius.
trophies.tip: The bank-vault route is the reliable one — the standalone truck method is a shortcut, not the requirement.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. Work in a grid, island by island, and watch the fog peel back behind you — the far corners (the Keys, the swamps, the northern counties) are the ones players most often leave half-covered. Pair this with the WAiNK scans and vehicle scans: one long flight can clear fog, scan landmarks and spot new vehicles at the same time.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and take off over Leonida.
Fly a grid over every fogged area until the map is fully visible.
Check the map edges and islands — they are the usual leftovers.
trophies.tip: PowerPyx has a dedicated unfogging route with the best plane for the job; a slow, high flight beats a fast, low one for coverage.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need to rob one operation belonging to each gang — but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so you will unlock it automatically on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs: scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed. Criminals at these operations are also the ideal targets for Gunslinger's five-kill Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob illegal operations (yellow map icons) as you find them.
Check Progress > Gangs to see which of the 9 gangs you still owe an operation.
Rob one operation per gang — then keep going to all 39 for the checklist.
trophies.tip: Use gang operations to practise Combat Focus: five clustered criminals are exactly what Gunslinger needs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. As of launch day, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — the description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but nobody has published a verified way to trigger it. The honest approach: try the bars and beachfront viewpoints along Ocean Beach and see what the game offers, and check the cited guides for updates as players confirm it. Do not trust an unconfirmed method from a random post: this guide will only claim what a named source has verified. The trophy is not missable — Ocean Beach is open in free roam after the story, so you lose nothing by waiting for a confirmed method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and try the beachfront bars and viewpoints.
Watch for a cocktail prompt or interaction with a view.
If nothing triggers it, wait for a confirmed method — check the PowerPyx guide for updates.
trophies.tip: Flagged honestly as unconfirmed at launch. Any guide that claims a precise method for this trophy without a source is guessing.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it straight through the showroom window. The car is the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the blue Banshee, drive forward and straight through the window — the trophy only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not from any other car. The pop is slightly delayed and lands after you drive further away down the street. It is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window and keep driving until it pops.
trophies.tip: If it does not pop immediately, keep driving — the unlock is delayed, and any other car in the showroom will not count.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically during Chapter 2. Inside the bowling alley, pick up: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the remaining valuables — so this trophy is not missable, and you do not need all three in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
During (or after) the Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, enter Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), and blow the safe (north-east hallway). Escape the police to pop it.
trophies.tip: You do not need all three valuables in one run — if one is missed, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for it.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase strength by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club and always go together with both characters — call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) — because while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, doubling your progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always work out with both characters together (call your partner first).
Raise both characters' strength to maximum — the trophy pops when both are maxed.
trophies.tip: Training together is the whole trick: the partner's automatic training means two maxed characters take barely longer than one.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see your count by clicking this trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. Profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them, shooting limbs), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, which makes cops more aggressive, so avoid pushing into it. You will almost certainly get this naturally while earning the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If you still need some at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but note that cops are more likely to shoot on sight at Psycho or Irredeemable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — every robbery and enemy encounter counts toward the 500.
If you are short at the end, farm actions by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.tip: Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes every later trophy harder by turning the police permanently hostile.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. As of launch day, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — but that is an unconfirmed guess, not a verified method. The honest approach is to keep the Payday Loans angle in mind while you play (you rob Payday Loans as part of Yasmani's questline in Chapter 3) and to check the cited guides for a confirmed method as players verify it. Do not trust a precise method from an unsourced post. The trophy is not missable: Payday Loans locations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Note the unconfirmed lead: the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Play Yasmani's Payday Loans robberies in Chapter 3 and watch for a second-attempt trigger.
Check the PowerPyx guide for a confirmed method before grinding anything.
trophies.tip: Flagged honestly as unconfirmed at launch — the name ('second time's the charm') suggests retrying something, but no source has verified what.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. As of launch day, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline — again, an unconfirmed guess rather than a verified method. The honest approach: explore the stranger and oddity content (the Skunk Ape strand for Kirk is the confirmed weird-quest line so far) and check the cited guides for updates as the UFO content is found and verified. Do not trust a precise method from an unsourced post. Nothing about this trophy is missable — the open world stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Keep the unconfirmed lead in mind: a UFO questline.
Explore stranger content (Kirk's Skunk Ape strand is the confirmed oddity line).
Check the PowerPyx guide for a confirmed method before grinding anything.
trophies.tip: Flagged honestly as unconfirmed at launch. If a guide claims an exact UFO location without a source, it is guessing.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. As of launch day, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, which matches the description, but the exact trigger is unverified. The honest approach: while riding a motorcycle, try melee kicks against enemies and watch for the pop, and check the cited guides for a confirmed method. Do not trust a precise method from an unsourced post. It is not missable — motorcycles and enemies are everywhere in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Ride a motorcycle near enemies.
Try melee kicks (a melee drive-by) against them.
Check the PowerPyx guide for a confirmed method if it does not pop.
trophies.tip: Flagged honestly as unconfirmed at launch. The bowling name is a pun on Let's Go Bowling, not a hint that it happens at the bowling alley.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all your robberies — you do not need to deliver it all at once. This comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist: the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most).
trophies.tip: Bank vaults are the fastest source — one vault can pay up to $205,000 — so this trophy usually pops during the Maximum Withdrawal grind.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — so you are never short of places to spend. This pops naturally if you buy gear for the other trophies (body armor, sticky bombs, gym memberships, garage purchases all count as shop spending where the game tracks it); if you are short at the end, buy car mods and tattoos until the total crosses $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.
Track the running total in the trophy list.
Top it up with car mods or tattoos if you are short at the end.
trophies.tip: Money for this comes fastest from the bank-vault robberies (up to $205,000 per vault), so do this trophy after Maximum Withdrawal, not before.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone — buy the garages through that app. The 4 story-related garages do not count; only the 8 purchasable ones do. The quickest money for them is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each garage adds parking spots you need to register vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app ($160,000 total).
The 4 story garages do not count — only the 8 bought ones.
trophies.tip: Buy the garages before grinding On the Spot: each one adds the parking spots you need to register 10 vehicles.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you must first own enough garages (see Little Boxes): each garage adds one or more parking spots, and you need the spots before you can register that many vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) so you have enough parking spots.
Drive cheap stolen cars and bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register — 10 times.
trophies.tip: Start with tracker-free cars: Moses only accepts those at first, and cheap cars keep the registration fees low.
